feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Fisheries
feeds.description: ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more - from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations. In the Fisheries section read the latest research on sustainable fisheries, threats to fishing, and the future of commercial fishing.

feeds.title: American Fisheries Society
feeds.description: The American Fisheries Society is the world's oldest and largest organization dedicated to strengthening the fisheries profession, advancing fisheries science, and conserving fisheries resources. The American Fisheries Society includes 8,000+ members from around the world, including fisheries managers, biologists, professors, ecologists, aquaculturists, economists, engineers, geneticists, and social scientists.

feeds.title: Pacific Fishery Management Council
feeds.description: The Pacific Fishery Management Council is one of eight regional fishery management councils established by the Magnuson Fishery Conservation and Management Act of 1976. We recommend fishery management measures in the Federal waters off Washington, Oregon, and California.

feeds.title: Sustainable Fisheries
feeds.description: The Sustainable Fisheries UW project is made up of a network of scientists whose mission has evolved out of frustration with erroneous stories about fisheries sustainability that continue to appear in mainstream media. Our mission is to communicate the science, policies, and human dimensions of sustainable fisheries.

feeds.title: Freshwater Fisheries Society of BC
feeds.description: The Freshwater Fisheries Society of BC is a non-profit organization. Our mandate is to enhance and conserve BC's freshwater fisheries for public benefit. Working in partnership with the government, industry, and anglers, our goal is to make fishing in BC even better through the enhancement and conservation of BC's freshwater fish resources.

feeds.title: Women of Fisheries
feeds.description: The Women of Fisheries represents over 1,700 women within the fisheries and aquatic sciences field across the globe. The goal of our organization is to provide a forum where women in fisheries science can connect, share stories, ask questions, learn from each other, and work together to tackle some of the issues facing women in our field.

feeds.title: Fishery Nation
feeds.description: Fisherynation was created for all fishermen of every region, enabling them to interact with one another regionally and to discuss their regional issues utilizing the democratic process to come to a consensus, then being supported by fishermen from around the country for political activism, lobbying our representatives as one united front. You can find Sea stories, engineer how-to articles, favorite recipes from the cook, crew stories, and picture essays that would be interesting and appreciated, subject to review.

feeds.title: About Seafood
feeds.description: The National Fisheries Institute (NFI) is a non-profit dedicated to education about seafood safety, sustainability & nutrition. From healthy eating and sustainable fishing to responsible aquaculture and a marketplace supporting free trade, the National Fisheries Institute (NFI) and AboutSeafood.com work to ensure the media, consumers, and regulators have the facts about seafood.

feeds.title: Magnolia Fisheries
feeds.description: We are Lake Management professionals. We are both responsive to our customers and responsible for our environment. You'll get science-based, innovative recommendations and great service at a fair price. We will not sell products or services you don't need. Most lake and pond owners find Magnolia Fisheries presents the best overall value for both quality results and overall cost.

feeds.title: Australian Marine Conservation Society » Fisheries
feeds.description: Over 57 years ago the Australian Marine Conservation Society was formed by a community of scientists and ocean conservationists, who came together to take action to protect our marine life. Explore the fisheries section and is where you will the latest update to AMCS's GoodFish Sustainable Seafood Guide, and much more.

feeds.title: The Fish Site
feeds.description: The Fish Site is a knowledge-sharing platform with premium news, analysis, and resources for the aquaculture industries. Led by senior editor Rob Fletcher, our international team of contributors is guided by our vision for sustainable aquaculture, reporting on the economics, environment, and ethics of contemporary food chain challenges. We challenge the status quo to create understanding, opportunity, and innovation.

feeds.title: IntraFish » Fisheries
feeds.description: For over 20 years, IntraFish has led the world in seafood, fisheries, and aquaculture news and business intelligence. We provide round-the-clock coverage of events as they happen and offer a considered analysis of the industry's biggest issues. Explore the Fisheries section for the best news, insight, and opinion covering the global seafood, fisheries, and aquaculture business.

feeds.title: Monterey Bay Fisheries Trust
feeds.description: The Monterey Bay Fisheries Trust is a nonprofit working to ensure that our coastal communities benefit from active, working waterfronts and local, sustainable seafood for years to come. Our mission is to advance the social, economic, and environmental sustainability of Monterey Bay fisheries. At the Monterey Bay Fisheries Trust, we are committed to environmental justice, and embrace a culture of diversity, inclusion, and equity for all.

feeds.title: The Fisheries Blog
feeds.description: The Fisheries Blog was started in 2011 by a group of scientists who are professional fisheries scientists by day and communicators of scientific information by night. On The Fisheries Blog, we write popular articles and other short fisheries-related stories that are often inspired by the interesting topics that we hear about during the day.

feeds.title: The Leader Creek Blog
feeds.description: Leader Creek Fisheries began operations in 1999 with one goal in mind - to produce the highest quality Bristol Bay Sockeye fillets, period. Leader Creek has been first in quality and innovation and our fishermen are the best in the Bay. Our fishermen understand what it takes to deliver the highest quality fish and they adhere to the highest quality handling practices from the point of harvest to the point of off-loading. From there, we process these beautiful sockeye salmon using state-of-the-art filleting, freezing, and packaging equipment.

feeds.title: Public Fishery Alliance Blog
feeds.description: We are fighting to protect your right to fish in freshwater and saltwater both today and for future generations. Your access to public fisheries are being threatened by extreme environmental groups, government under funding and mismanagement. Our role is to lobby governments and build relationships to ensure we have access to public fisheries in BC.
